explanationMd: The first absolute value is 7. The second is |−5| = 5. Their difference is 7 − 5 = 2. Evaluate each absolute value before performing the outer subtraction.

distractorRationale.c: This keeps the negative signs instead of evaluating absolute values.

distractorRationale.d: This fails to evaluate the expression inside the second absolute value.
